Marta (PM): Quick sync — infra flagged a Dedicated capacity dip next week, pilots asking for bulk embeddings in MVP. Need a decision on scope.
Evan (Eng): Short summary of pilot needs?
Riya (CS): Two pilots: interactive p50 <=220ms; nightly bulk ~6-8M tokens. Theyre ok paying for reserved slots if we can commit.
Ken (Infra): We lose ~25% Dedicated GPUs for maintenance. Autoscale handles spikes but sustained nightly runs will queue.
Marta (PM): Options: 1) include bulk with reserved carve (ops + billing), 2) ship MVP without bulk and add in v1, 3) hybrid: public no-bulk, pilot opt-in carve. Thoughts?
Evan (Eng): Hybrid seems safest: public timeline intact, pilots get feature behind org flag + routing to reserved pool. Add fallback to quantized model on overload.
Zoe (Design): If hybrid, hide bulk-upload in public flows and show "Pilot: bulk enabled" in org settings. Small microcopy change.
Riya (CS): I'll push pilots for a signed LOI for reserved capacity. Verbal ok for now. If no LOI by EOD+2 we auto-disable pilot bulk.
Ken (Infra): For carve we can reserve 2 GPUs nightly 02:00-06:00 UTC. Needs ~48h to provision and test. I'll add dashboard panels and alerts.
Evan (Eng): Work estimates: flag (1d), routing+tests (2d), canary (0.5d). Fallback triggers at queue>70%.
ci-bot: deploy scheduled: feat/pilot-bulk-gate -> staging at 2619876550
Marta (PM): Decision: go hybrid. Action owners: Evan (flag+routing), Ken (provision+dash), Zoe (UI), Riya (contracts). Reopen if legal or infra blocks appear. :thumbsup:
